meaning: w_WC(phi) is a CERTIFIED LOWER BOUND, uniform over the phi-bin, on the area of a set that is (i) dead for the single tilted square whose corner touches the wall at p (A23 deadness, plane mode via Lemma P/P'), (ii) interior-disjoint from that square, and (iii) contained in slab(wall, along-wall bbox of the square) x [0, cos+sin] (Lemma K).  By A23 Lemma 2 the areas of pairwise interior-disjoint such sets add against the budget s^2 - 11.  NO MOAT and NO rho_min clip: this is the FULL dead region of the wedge pair inside the Lemma-K slab, unlike A45's ownership charge.

convention.frame: A45 WC frame: big container S = 20, square corner at p = (10,0) on the bottom wall, tilt phi in the bin, D4-reduced to (0,45]
convention.bin_uniformity: nsub tilt sub-boxes, PlacedBox core-box-uniform, outward-rounded rational (cos,sin) hulls
convention.resolution: cell0 = 1/8 quadtree down to min_cell = 1/64; undecided tiles DROPPED (lower bound)
convention.lemma_K: slab test, a45_lib.keeper_wc verbatim; tiles outside the slab are dropped, which is what makes the entry container-independent and along-wall composable
convention.radial_profile: exact area of the certified tiles within SUP-distance r of p (tiles clipped exactly), r in 1/8..13/8
